clues.kinetics: Clearance rises with body weight, but less than proportionally, and persistent anti-drug antibodies raise it about 3-fold. Renal or hepatic insufficiency has not been studied.
clues.substance: A recombinant, humanized protein made in murine myeloma cells, with a molecular weight of 149 kilodaltons.
clues.product: Approved under a BLA as a single-dose 300 mg/15 mL vial for dilution, dosed every four weeks.
clues.safety: Boxed warning for progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy, a viral brain infection often fatal or severely disabling. Contraindicated in PML and prior hypersensitivity; headache and fatigue are most common.
clues.indication: Relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis as monotherapy, and moderately to severely active Crohn's disease.
clues.mechanism: Binds α4β1 and α4β7 integrins on all leukocytes except neutrophils, blocking their adhesion and migration into inflamed tissue.

tell: An α4-integrin antibody dispensed only through registered infusion centers, under a boxed PML warning.
